facts.fact: The Department of Communications and Digital Technologies gazetted the Draft South Africa National Artificial Intelligence Policy for public comment (the article says 10 April; the draft's gazette notice is dated 2026-04-09).
facts.system: South Africa National Artificial Intelligence Policy

facts.fact: The communications minister withdrew the draft policy 16 days after it was gazetted, after journalists found fabricated references in it; the article gives no exact withdrawal date, so the date is computed from 10 April.
facts.system: South Africa National Artificial Intelligence Policy
